description: As AI moves beyond screens and into the physical world, humanoid robots are learning to walk, interact and adapt to their surroundings. But why give AI a human-like body? What does a body add to intelligence, and can humanoids move beyond impressive demos to become part of everyday life? Join this episode of THE HYPE with Dean Yang and our guests Gao Yang, assistant professor at the Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS), Tsinghua University, and Zhang Haonan, assistant rese…
classificationReason: Dedicated expert discussion of humanoid robot bodies, learning, interaction, adaptation, and deployment in daily life.
qualityReason: Named university researchers and a focused conceptual and technical discussion indicate substantive original interview content.
